svg.text: HDIP 0.1 — M15-V07: Governance, Security, Access & Consequence
Governed Product access does not confer authority for downstream Decisions or Actions
BND-05 — Enterprise Policy, Legal & Control Authority
Policy authorship · Legal interpretation · Risk/control ownership
Exceptions, waivers and accountable governance decisions
Authority remains external to HDIP compilation/enforcement
Authentication, credentials, purpose and scoped access facts
Identity and entitlement are not universal authority
External authority is referenced or consulted, not silently transferred to the HDIP platform.
HDIP — GOVERNED CONTEXT AND CROSS-CUTTING COORDINATION
P1 — Governed Intent, Definition & Authority Context
INT-03 P1 → P4: governing consumption context
Coordinate enforcement and evidence; retain authority
Governing change and revocation: INT-08 P1 → affected P2/P3/P4/P5 · Clarification: INT-06 P4 → P1
P4 — PROVISION, CONSUMPTION & INTEGRATION: GOVERNED PRODUCT ACCESS
Illustrative access-decision responsibilities; not five mandatory runtime hops
Product entitlement authorizes a governed Product/Port use only — not every subsequent downstream purpose or consequence.
P2 provides Product/contract resolution; P4 mediates consumer access; INT-17 / INT-18 govern applicable P4 ↔ P3 invocation/results.
A valid decision remains subject to scope, governing purpose, policy change, version/currentness and applicable evidence.
AFTER ACCESS: DISTINCT CONSUMPTION AND CONSEQUENCE RESPONSIBILITIES
Ordinary governed consumption — no new Decision authority
Explore, browse or query Product content
Use dashboards, reports, APIs or analytical views
No Product creation is implied by consumption
Consequential controls, mandate & human oversight where applicable
GEAIRA / enterprise authority controls the applicable consequence
CROSS-CUTTING OVERLAYS — ORTHOGONAL TO THE FIVE PLANES
HDIP-FND — Shared Platform / Utility Foundation: compute, storage, messaging, IAM integration and runtime enablement
HDIP-CLA 0.1 · M15-V07 · Frozen M17 semantics · Presentation-only Reference View · No prescribed deployment topology or approval workflow
An AI Agent is not automatically a delegated authority
Registration, access or runtime success ≠ Product qualification
BND-05 — External policy, legal & control owners
Authority boundaries persist across the path.
No transitive entitlement from an upstream Port.

INT-17 P4 → P3 typed runtime invocation
INT-18 P3 → P4 runtime results or effects
